bus_dispatch.note: Re-baselined 2026-06-11 (GH #125): the cooperative bus queue is now bounded (default 8192-cell cap). This bench floods the queue; bounding it cut maxrss 57256->9564 KB AND elapsed 8.74->3.03 ms — the bounded ~4.5 MB queue is far more cache-friendly than the old ~55 MB unbounded one. Past the cap the publisher inline-drains (backpressure) instead of buffering the whole backlog.

bus_dispatch_cross_pool.note: F.32-1 baseline (2026-05-25). Cross-pool bus dispatch from main to io pool, 100k iters. Timed region NOW INCLUDES consumer-side drain (poll-wait on self.sub.count until iters) — F.32-4-prefetch's contribution materializes here. Pre-2026-05-25 the bench timed publisher-only and prefetch was invisible (baseline was 8.80 ms). Tolerance 0.40 because cross-thread scheduling variance + sleep granularity widen the spread. | Re-baselined 2026-05-29: the increase to ~20ms is correctness-driven — the per-arena subregion_lock (2026-05-26), the 3a9c991 bus_queue_drain race fix, and 0d1f956's per-thread-correct wire dispatch (serialize + per-subscriber deserialize to honor the single-threaded-method invariant). A flat-payload, local-only serialize-skip optimization is a deferred follow-up; the residual here is not a perf bug.

form_hashmap_false_sharing.note: F.32-1γ-v1 baseline (2026-05-25). Two-pool concurrent writers into a shared @form(hashmap, sync = lockfree, cap = 300000). 100k inserts per writer = 200k total. γ-v1 uses cell-level CAS (3-state occupancy) with NO rwlock or mutex — pure atomic ops on slot[0] + memcpy. On this 2-core / cheap-payload bench: γ-v1 is ~1.39x faster than α (serialized) and ~2.54x faster than β2-v2 (striped+rwlock); closes the gap with Go's sync.Mutex map from 1.66x to 1.18x. γ-v1 is fixed-cap (no grow) and remove-less — author sized cap to 1.5x expected entries to keep linear-probe latency bounded. | Re-baselined 2026-06-11: pre-existing drift vs the 05-25 baseline (confirmed ~16.8M on the pre-#125 bus-queue-change binary — this bench has no bus constructs, so the bus-queue change is not on its code path). 2-core false-sharing variance; correctness-driven drift from changes since 05-25, not a perf bug and not from #125.

form_hashmap_walk_large.note: Re-baselined 2026-06-25 (15-iter median): key_at/entry_at are now O(1) dense-indexed access, not the O(N) linear scan the prior note assumed — the full 100k walk dropped 6911 ms -> 1.31 ms (~5700x). Verified correct (len=100000, sum=14999850000). The earlier 'O(N^2) by design / slow' framing is obsolete; this now measures O(N) iteration throughput on a working set past L1/L2. Prior value was last measured 2026-05-24.

bus_dispatch_heap_payload.note: Re-baselined 2026-06-25 (15-iter median): 4.84 -> 2.08 ms, maxrss 31456 -> 10112 KB — the GH #125 bounded bus queue (8192-cell cap), same signature as bus_dispatch.

form_hashmap_get.note: Re-baselined 2026-06-25 (15-iter median): 8.87 -> 4.96 ms, a real improvement since the 05-25/06-11 baselines (faster hashmap lookup path). No bus constructs, so independent of GH #125; cause not pinned to a specific commit. maxrss ~flat. 2026-06-28: HIGH-VARIANCE bench — a 500k-entry (~49 MB) hashmap makes the lookup loop dominated by cache/TLB + CPU-boost state; observed 4.4-13 ms run-to-run (a 3x spread), and core-pinning can DOUBLE it. The 4.96 ms baseline is the cool-machine median (min today 4.41 ms still beats it); the lookup path is untouched since, so elevated medians under sustained load are environmental (X3D thermal), not a regression. Tolerance widened 0.3 -> 0.5 to stop spurious flags; bench on a cool, idle machine for a clean reading.

locus_instantiation.note: Re-baselined 2026-05-29. The per-arena subregion_lock correctness fix (2026-05-26, cross-pool freelist race) raised this ~91% (1.79->3.94ms). hale 856dc7d's single-thread fast-path recovered most of it (->~2.43ms); the residual is the per-arena mutex init, removable only by a lock-free subregion freelist (deferred follow-up). Measured on the dev box; the prior 1.785ms baseline was faster hardware (pre-mutex control here was ~1.99ms).

pipeline_3stage.note: Re-baselined 2026-06-25 (15-iter median): 7.52 -> 3.81 ms, maxrss 39124 -> 9712 KB — a 3-stage bus pipeline; the GH #125 bounded bus queue is on its hot path.

stream_aggregator.note: Re-baselined 2026-06-25 (15-iter median): 18.11 -> 5.26 ms and maxrss 109584 -> 9732 KB. The bounded cooperative bus queue (GH #125, default 8192-cell cap) replaced the unbounded backlog — same cache-friendliness win recorded on bus_dispatch; this bus-heavy app benefits most (~11x less resident).

json_parse.note: JSON parse throughput: 200k parses of a 7-field market-data quote via the inlined Type::from_json. ~1.15x behind V8 JSON.parse, beats Go encoding/json ~2.4x and Python json.loads ~3.5x. Baselined 2026-06-09 after inline-parser + string-fast-path + byte_at/range_eq leaf-primitive inlining (was ~291ms via the cursor).

form_chunk_hint_multi_locus.note: Baselined 2026-06-25 (15-iter median) — previously untracked (a .hl with no baseline entry, so it gated nothing). @form chunk-hint across multiple loci; ~203 ms.
